task_instance: Created a small sample project with a scripts/ folder (analyze.py, clean.py, fetch_data.py, report.js, README.md) and a top-level README.md containing an existing '## Files in scripts' placeholder section. Wrote update_index.py implementing the skill's process (scan target markdown, discover files in folder matching a pattern, extract per-file descriptions from headers/docstrings/comments, build a Detailed Table per the skill's Option 2, locate an existing index-like heading via keyword matching, and replace its body while preserving the rest of the document; or append a new section if none exists). Ran it against README.md (existing section, pattern '*') and against docs/other.md (no existing section, pattern '*.py').
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/github__awesome-copilot__update-markdown-file-index . Ran `python3 update_index.py --file README.md --folder scripts --pattern '*'` -> replaced the existing '## Files in scripts' section with a 5-row markdown table (analyze.py, clean.py, fetch_data.py, README.md, report.js), sorted alphabetically, with correct relative links (e.g. [analyze.py](scripts/analyze.py)), inferred descriptions pulled from each file's first docstring/comment/heading line, and left the surrounding '## Overview' and '## Footer' sections untouched. Ran `python3 update_index.py --file docs/other.md --folder scripts --pattern '*.py'` on a file with no existing index section -> correctly appended a new '## Files in ../scripts' section containing only the 3 .py files (pattern filter respected) with correct '../scripts/...' relative links. Verified markdown validity by parsing both output files with the python 'markdown' library (tables extension) and confirming '<table>' rendered in the resulting HTML for both files. Files produced: update_index.py, README.md, docs/other.md, scripts/*.md/*.py/*.js in the work directory.
